objective: Unify social photo/video presentation across Community and Marites: source-aware rendering, stale recycled-image callback isolation, shared resilient photo loading, and instant cached video poster continuity. Preserve private media authorization, feed geometry, playback/ad behavior, weak-network safeguards and existing runtime.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android Production OTA run #249 published update 01a1a62f-f53e-7569-a4ef-306df0e0082b on production channel, Android runtime 1.3.2, from source SHA 4ed0d427b54c9ced99dfc0615b19f8cfac8dabab. Current main includes later non-OTA source changes; this branch is DEV-only until its own exact-head gates and a new RC/OTA.
chosenApproach: Guard Android image callbacks against stale media identity, signed URL and renderer completions; reuse the shared private-media cache/recovery image component for Marites photo collages; keep the best cached/generated video poster visible over the active Expo Video surface until the first playback frame begins.
selectionRationale: Fix cross-surface rendering inconsistencies at shared boundaries without replacing Expo Image/Video, changing native dependencies, weakening signed-media authorization, or eagerly mounting offscreen players.
riskAreas: Marites collage layout and tap targets
preserveBehaviors: Private signed media URLs and exact scope authorization
Stable media cache keys and bounded re-sign/retry
No stale image callbacks may overwrite a recycled tile
Original aspect ratios and collage geometry
One active player per visible video and no offscreen speculative video downloads
Persistent bounded video byte cache and poster cache
IMA ads, companion placements, sound and fullscreen behavior
No DB/RLS/storage/native dependency or package identity changes
acceptanceChecks: Android stale load/display/error callbacks cannot mark a recycled tile as painted or update parent dimensions
Marites photo collage uses the shared cache-aware media renderer without changing press targets or collage geometry
Cached/generated video first-frame poster remains visible while the active player is starting and is removed after playback begins
Signed URL authorization and refresh logic remain intact
Video cache remains bounded and playback retries remain bounded
All focused media regression tests and TypeScript pass
Engineering accountability and integration/performance QA pass on the exact current-base PR head
Physical-device verification is explicitly skipped per user instruction; no device-render claim is made
alternativeApproaches: Bulk merge stale media PR branches without current-base reconciliation (rejected: they diverge substantially from Main and overlap source files).
Remove all image/video recovery and weak-network limits (rejected: would permit request storms and unsafe resource usage).
Replace media engines or add a native CDN/player module (rejected: unnecessary APK/runtime change).
